problem: Freelancers and gig workers need a quick, offline‑first way to create professional invoices without complex software or paid services, often ending up with ad‑hoc spreadsheets that look unprofessional.
solution: A static web app that lets users input client, service, and rate details, generates a printable PDF‑like invoice, and stores past invoices in localStorage for reuse.

competitors.name: Invoice Ninja
competitors.difference: Full SaaS with recurring fees; our tool is free, static, no backend.

competitors.name: Wave Invoicing
competitors.difference: Offers accounting suite; we focus solely on quick invoice creation offline.

features: Create invoice with client, service line items, tax, and totals
Save invoices locally and reload for editing
Responsive design for mobile and desktop

monetization.pricing_hypothesis: Offer a paid export to PDF feature after 100 free invoices per year.
monetization.free_tier: Unlimited invoice creation, local storage, and printing

operating_costs: Current prototype: ₹0 within published free‑tier limits
launch_strategy: Publish repo on GitHub and enable GitHub Pages
Share on freelancer forums, Reddit r/freelance, and LinkedIn groups
Collect feedback via a short Google Form linked from the app

marketing_content.tagline: Professional invoices in seconds, no account needed.
marketing_content.social_post: 🚀 Launching Simple Invoice Builder – a free, offline‑first web app for freelancers to create clean, printable invoices in seconds. No sign‑up, no fees. Try it now! https://yourusername.github.io/simple-invoice-builder/

tests: Enter valid client data and line items → preview updates with correct totals and tax.
Leave required fields empty → form shows validation messages and prevents preview.
Refresh page after creating invoices → saved invoices reappear in the list.
next_improvements: Add PDF generation using jsPDF library
Support multiple currencies and custom branding
Sync invoices via optional Google Drive backup
